senses.en: The main facts or ideas supporting something.
The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a sound basis.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于坚实的基础的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects a sound basis with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把坚实的基础和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: form the basis of｜构成……的基础
tip: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

senses.en: A scientist who studies living things.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on marine biologist.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论海洋生物学家。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of marine biologist.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得海洋生物学家这个例子。

tip: 研究海洋生物的专家称为marine biologist。

senses.en: Pay someone to work for you.
Use a method, skill, or resource for a purpose.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer employ staff during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时雇用员工。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers employ staff before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要雇用员工。

col: employ someone as｜雇用某人担任
tip: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。

senses.en: the way someone feels at a particular time
the feeling that a place, event, or artwork creates

ex.en: I copied mood swings into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把情绪波动抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mood swings.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论情绪波动的材料。

col: in the mood for｜有心情做……
tip: in the mood for后接名词；接动词用to do。

senses.en: The ability to see.
The act of seeing or the area that can be seen.
Something seen, especially something impressive or worth visiting.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on out of sight.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论在视野之外。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around out of sight.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕在视野之外展开说明。

tip: 视力通常不可数；表示名胜常用复数sights。

senses.en: to put equipment or software in place for use
to formally place someone in an important position

ex.en: The professor asked us to install software.
ex.zh: 教授让我们安装软件。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to install software.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得安装软件。

col: install solar panels｜安装太阳能板
tip: 下载是download；下载后安装才是install。

senses.en: Someone who studies or writes about the past.

ex.en: Office hours began with a leading historian.
ex.zh: 答疑从杰出的历史学家开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a leading historian.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕杰出的历史学家展开说明。

col: a leading historian｜杰出的历史学家
a historian of science｜科学史学家
tip: historian指研究者；historical表示与历史有关。

senses.en: To make someone feel slightly angry or irritated.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to annoy someone.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何惹某人生气。

ex.en: The reading asks you to annoy someone and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你惹某人生气，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 人感到烦用annoyed；事物令人烦用annoying。

senses.en: to a greater degree or a more distant place
additional or more advanced
to help something develop or succeed

ex.en: The professor told us to further information and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们更多信息，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will further information when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会更多信息。

col: further your career｜促进职业发展
tip: further可指程度或距离；farther主要指距离。

senses.en: a medical examination to assess your general health

ex.en: I wrote check-up on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把check-up和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: A reading on public health uses check-up when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于公共卫生的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了体检。

tip: check-up是名词；check up on意为查看或核查。

senses.en: Feeling worried and unable to relax
Pronounced with greater emphasis than surrounding sounds
Experiencing physical force that may cause strain or damage

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on stressed about exams.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论为考试焦虑。

ex.en: The reading connects stressed about exams with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把为考试焦虑和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: highly stressed components｜承受高应力的部件
tip: 也可作stress的过去式或过去分词，表示“强调”。

senses.en: Giving pleasure or making you feel happy

ex.en: Office hours began with highly enjoyable.
ex.zh: 答疑从非常令人愉快的开始。

ex.en: The author returns to highly enjoyable when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了非常令人愉快的。

tip: 形容活动令人愉快用 enjoyable，不用 enjoyed。

senses.en: several related things or events following one another
a set of programmes or books sharing characters or a subject

ex.en: I copied a television series into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把电视系列节目抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of a television series.
ex.zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得电视系列节目这个例子。

col: a series of events｜一连串事件
a television series｜电视系列节目
tip: 单复数同形：a series；two series。

senses.en: Liquid produced by your skin when hot or nervous.
To produce liquid through your skin.

ex.en: The textbook introduces wipe away sweat in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了擦去汗水。

ex.en: A campus survey used wipe away sweat to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用擦去汗水来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: break into a sweat｜突然出汗
tip: 汗水通常不可数；出一身汗可说a sweat。

senses.en: used to refer to one specific person, thing, or situation
greater or more noticeable than usual
having strong preferences and being difficult to satisfy

ex.en: I copied a particular reason into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把某个特定原因抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a particular reason when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了某个特定原因。

col: a particular reason｜某个特定原因
tip: in particular意为尤其；be particular about表示对……讲究。

senses.en: To guide people or cause something to happen
The position of being ahead of others
A soft, heavy, grey metal that can be poisonous

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to lead to.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何导致。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers lead to before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要导致。

tip: 铅读/led/；动词读/liːd/，过去式和过去分词为led。

senses.en: The function or responsibility someone or something has.
A character played by an actor in a performance.

ex.en: I copied a key role into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把关键作用抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a key role to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用关键作用来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: play a role in｜在……中起作用
take on a role｜承担职责
tip: 表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。

senses.en: To break rules dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage.
To deceive someone to obtain something unfairly.
A person who acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.

ex.en: The professor asked us to cheat in an exam.
ex.zh: 教授让我们考试作弊。

ex.en: The reading asks you to cheat in an exam and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你考试作弊，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: cheat in an exam｜考试作弊
cheat someone out of money｜骗取某人的钱
tip: cheat someone out of something指骗走某人的某物。

senses.en: the system of producing, trading, and using goods and services
careful use of money, time, or resources to avoid waste

ex.en: I copied local economy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把地方经济抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used local economy to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用地方经济来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: economic指经济的；economical指节省的、划算的。

senses.en: Protection against danger, crime, loss, or unwanted access
People or activities responsible for protecting a place
Freedom from worries about losing money, work, or essential support

ex.en: Our professor circled data security on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数据安全。

ex.en: A campus survey used data security to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用数据安全来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。

senses.en: the qualities that shape how someone thinks, feels, and behaves
lively or appealing qualities that make someone interesting
a well-known person, especially in entertainment or broadcasting

ex.en: I copied outgoing personality into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把外向的性格抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of outgoing personality.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得外向的性格这个例子。

tip: 指性格时可数；have personality指有个人魅力。

senses.en: Having a lower rank or less experience in an organisation
Intended for younger people or involving them
A younger person, or a student below the final year

ex.en: The textbook introduces junior staff in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了初级员工。

ex.en: The author returns to junior staff when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了初级员工。

tip: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

senses.en: Involving or affecting the whole world.
Considering all parts of something rather than individual details.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about global warming.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于全球变暖的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to global warming when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了全球变暖。

tip: global强调全球范围；international强调国家之间。

senses.en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
an illness or physical problem

ex.en: The textbook introduces a formal complaint in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了正式投诉。

ex.en: The reading connects a formal complaint with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把正式投诉和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a common complaint｜常见病症；常见抱怨
tip: complaint是名词，complain是动词；投诉某事用about。

senses.zh: 不断增加的；日益增长的
senses.en: becoming greater in amount, size, number, or degree

ex.en: I copied increasing demand into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把日益增长的需求抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of increasing demand.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得日益增长的需求这个例子。

col: an increasing number of｜越来越多的
tip: increasing修饰名词；increasingly修饰形容词等。

senses.en: the process of making or growing things for use
the making of a film or play, or the resulting work

ex.en: I copied mass production into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把大规模生产抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mass production.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大规模生产展开说明。

tip: production通常不可数；指一部演出作品时可数。

senses.en: A restaurant where customers collect food and carry it to tables.

ex.en: Office hours began with a school cafeteria.
ex.zh: 答疑从学校食堂开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a school cafeteria when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学校食堂。

tip: 强调自行取餐，不一定是不限量的自助餐。

senses.en: A regular or repeated way something happens or is done.
An arrangement of shapes, lines, or colours forming a design.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a floral pattern.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于花卉图案的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a floral pattern.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕花卉图案展开说明。

col: a pattern of behaviour｜行为模式
follow a pattern｜遵循某种模式
tip: 表示规律常用a pattern of＋名词。

senses.en: Someone employed to do household work in another person's home

ex.en: Office hours began with domestic servant.
ex.zh: 答疑从家佣开始。

ex.en: The author returns to domestic servant when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了家佣。

tip: 公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。

senses.en: A substance that flows and takes the shape of its container.
In a form that flows freely rather than remaining solid.
Available as cash or easily converted into cash.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on clear liquid.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论透明液体。

ex.en: A campus survey used clear liquid to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用透明液体来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: liquid作名词指液体；liquid assets指现金或易变现资产。

senses.en: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern
to adjust an instrument so it produces the correct notes
to adjust a device to work or receive signals correctly

ex.en: I copied catchy tune into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把朗朗上口的曲调抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects catchy tune with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把朗朗上口的曲调和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: in tune指音调准确；out of tune指走调。

senses.en: someone who prepares and sells meat
to kill animals for meat or cut up their meat
to do something very badly, spoiling the result

ex.en: Our professor circled local butcher on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了当地肉贩。

ex.en: The reading connects local butcher with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把当地肉贩和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: butcher a song｜把一首歌唱砸
tip: 肉店常说the butcher's；动词也可指把表演等搞砸。

senses.en: A formal event marking an important occasion.
Formal behaviour required by tradition or social rules.

ex.en: I copied opening ceremony into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把开幕式抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used opening ceremony to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用开幕式来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 指具体典礼时可数；without ceremony意为不拘礼节。

senses.en: the process of taking air into and out of the lungs

ex.en: The textbook introduces deep breathing in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了深呼吸。

ex.en: A campus survey used deep breathing to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用深呼吸来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: breathing可作名词，也是breathe的现在分词。

senses.en: A person who is widely known by the public.
The state of being famous.

ex.en: The textbook introduces achieve celebrity in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了成名。

ex.en: The author returns to achieve celebrity when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了成名。

tip: 指名人时可数；指名气时通常不可数。

senses.en: connected with something in some way
belonging to the same family

ex.en: I copied closely related into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把密切相关的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of closely related.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得密切相关的这个例子。

col: related by marriage｜有姻亲关系的
tip: 常用be related to；to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: A public celebration with music, costumes, and street entertainment.
An outdoor event with rides, games, and entertainment.

ex.en: I copied an annual carnival into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把年度嘉年华抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an annual carnival.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论年度嘉年华的材料。

tip: 美式英语中也可指有游戏和游乐设施的游乐会。

senses.en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional.
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on above average.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高于平均水平。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of above average.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得高于平均水平这个例子。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: A person who manages library resources and helps library users.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on school librarian.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论学校图书馆员。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of school librarian.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得学校图书馆员这个例子。

col: ask a librarian｜咨询图书馆员
tip: library指图书馆；librarian指在那里工作的馆员。

senses.en: To remove written material or stored information.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to delete a file.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何删除文件。

ex.en: A lecture on technological change showed why researchers delete a file before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于技术变革的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要删除文件。

tip: 常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。

senses.en: something new that someone has designed or created
the act of creating something that did not exist before
a story or explanation created rather than based on facts

ex.en: Office hours began with a useful invention.
ex.zh: 答疑从实用的发明开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a useful invention.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕实用的发明展开说明。

tip: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。

senses.en: a structure with triangular sides meeting at a point
a system with fewer members at each successively higher level

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about ancient pyramid.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于古代金字塔的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of ancient pyramid.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得古代金字塔这个例子。

tip: 既指古代金字塔，也指几何中的棱锥体。

senses.en: An exciting story or film involving danger, suspense, or crime.

ex.en: I copied a crime thriller into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把犯罪惊悚作品抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a crime thriller to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用犯罪惊悚作品来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

col: a crime thriller｜犯罪惊悚作品
a psychological thriller｜心理惊悚作品
a political thriller｜政治惊悚作品
tip: thriller重悬念与紧张感，不等于恐怖片。

senses.en: heavier than is considered healthy, suitable, or officially allowed

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on overweight luggage.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论超重行李。

ex.en: The reading connects overweight luggage with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把超重行李和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常作形容词；obese指肥胖，程度更重。

senses.en: Great comfort and pleasure involving expensive surroundings or possessions.
Something enjoyable or expensive that is not essential.
Providing exceptional comfort and quality, usually at a high price.

ex.en: Our professor circled luxury goods on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了奢侈品。

ex.en: A campus survey used luxury goods to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用奢侈品来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: afford the luxury of｜有条件享受……
tip: 指奢华状态时不可数；指一项享受时可数。

senses.en: An expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune.

ex.en: I copied a letter of congratulation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把贺信抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a letter of congratulation to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用贺信来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

tip: 祝贺通常用复数congratulations，后接on加成就。

senses.en: a period of ten years

ex.en: The textbook introduces the next decade in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了未来十年。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the next decade.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕未来十年展开说明。

col: over the past decade｜在过去十年间
tip: a decade是十年；decades常泛指数十年。

senses.en: to include something as a necessary part
to make someone take part in an activity

ex.en: The professor asked us to involve doing something.
ex.zh: 教授让我们需要做某事。

ex.en: The passage says students who can involve doing something follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够需要做某事的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: involve someone in something｜让某人参与某事
tip: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

senses.en: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves
to affect someone's decisions, behaviour, or development

ex.en: Office hours began with a positive influence.
ex.zh: 答疑从积极的影响开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a positive influence with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把积极的影响和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: have an influence on｜对……有影响
tip: 名词后常接on；动词直接接宾语。

senses.en: An object added to make something look more attractive.
The process or style of making a place look attractive.
An official award worn to honour service or bravery.

ex.en: Office hours began with interior decoration.
ex.zh: 答疑从室内装饰开始。

ex.en: The author returns to interior decoration when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了室内装饰。

tip: 指装饰过程时不可数；指单件装饰品时可数。

senses.en: The work of organising and controlling activities or resources.
The people responsible for running an organisation.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on time management.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论时间管理。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss time management.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论时间管理的材料。

tip: 指管理工作时不可数；the management可指管理层。

senses.en: Someone who works on ships or sails boats

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on experienced sailor.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经验丰富的海员。

ex.en: The author returns to experienced sailor when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经验丰富的海员。

col: a crew of sailors｜一组船员
tip: 指在船上工作或驾驶帆船的人，不泛指乘客。

senses.en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation
all members of a group, or the total member count

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on annual membership.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论年度会员资格。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss annual membership.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论年度会员资格的材料。

col: renew your membership｜续办会员资格
tip: 表示加入某组织的资格，常用membership of。

senses.en: A room where art, music, or broadcasts are produced
A company that makes films
A flat combining living and sleeping space in one room

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on recording studio.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论录音室。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of recording studio.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得录音室这个例子。

tip: 英式studio flat、美式studio apartment均指单间公寓。

senses.en: To make someone feel afraid.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to frighten someone away.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求把某人吓跑。

ex.en: The reading asks you to frighten someone away and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你把某人吓跑，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: frighten someone into doing｜吓得某人去做
frighten someone to death｜把某人吓坏
tip: frightened指感到害怕的；frightening指令人害怕的。

senses.en: The activity or skill of taking photographs.

ex.en: The textbook introduces digital photography in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了数码摄影。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around digital photography.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕数码摄影展开说明。

col: take up photography｜开始学习摄影
tip: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

senses.en: The rounded back part of the foot below the ankle.
The raised part beneath the back of a shoe.

ex.en: Office hours began with heel pain.
ex.zh: 答疑从足跟疼痛开始。

ex.en: The author returns to heel pain when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了足跟疼痛。

tip: heel是脚后跟或鞋跟；heal意为愈合，二者同音。

senses.en: a person or organisation that purchases something
someone whose job is choosing goods for a business

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about potential buyer.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于潜在买家的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of potential buyer.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得潜在买家这个例子。

tip: buyer 指买方；customer 更强调店铺或服务的顾客。

senses.en: Money charged for a service, course, or professional advice.

ex.en: The textbook introduces entrance fee in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了入场费。

ex.en: A campus survey used entrance fee to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用入场费来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: fee指服务或入场等费用；小费通常用tip。

senses.en: The desire to eat food.
A strong desire to have or experience something.

ex.en: Our professor circled a healthy appetite on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了好胃口。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a healthy appetite.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕好胃口展开说明。

col: work up an appetite｜使胃口大开
tip: appetite for 除食欲外，也可表示对知识等的渴求。

senses.en: the title of a news report

senses.zh: 成为头条新闻；领衔演出
senses.en: to be the main news story or featured performer

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about front-page headline.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于头版标题的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects front-page headline with a larger point about public communication.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把头版标题和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: make headlines指成为新闻焦点，不是制作标题。

senses.en: to think carefully about something before deciding
to have a particular opinion about someone or something
to take someone or something into account

ex.en: The professor asked us to consider the consequences.
ex.zh: 教授让我们考虑后果。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers consider the consequences before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要考虑后果。

col: consider all options｜考虑所有选择
be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

senses.en: An arrangement allowing payment later or borrowing money.
Recognition that someone deserves for an achievement.
A unit earned towards a qualification by completing coursework.

ex.en: The textbook introduces buy on credit in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了赊购。

ex.en: A campus survey used buy on credit to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用赊购来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: give someone credit｜肯定某人的功劳
tip: on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。

senses.en: A covering worn over part or all of the face.
To hide something or make it less noticeable.

ex.en: Office hours began with face mask.
ex.zh: 答疑从口罩；面膜开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used face mask to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用口罩；面膜来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: wear a mask｜戴口罩；戴面具
tip: mask 作动词直接接宾语，表示掩盖问题或感受。

senses.en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family.
A member of a royal family.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about the royal family.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于王室的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the royal family.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕王室展开说明。

tip: royal指王室的；loyal指忠诚的，注意首字母。

senses.en: The typical weather conditions of a place over many years.
The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.

ex.en: Our professor circled mild climate on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了温和的气候。

ex.en: The author returns to mild climate when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了温和的气候。

tip: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

senses.en: Stories about imagined people and events.
Something invented that is presented as true.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on science fiction.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论科幻小说。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss science fiction.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论科幻小说的材料。

col: a work of fiction｜一部小说作品
tip: 统称小说时不可数；一部小说可说a work of fiction。

senses.en: To improve or prepare writing, images, or recordings by making changes.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to edit an essay.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何修改文章。

ex.en: The reading asks you to edit an essay and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你修改文章，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: edit强调修改或剪辑，publish才是出版或发布。

senses.en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.

ex.en: Office hours began with a brave decision.
ex.zh: 答疑从勇敢的决定开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a brave decision.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得勇敢的决定这个例子。

col: brave enough to｜有足够勇气做
tip: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

senses.en: in a way that is easy to see or understand

ex.en: The lab manual says to obviously pleased before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先明显很高兴，再记下数字。

ex.en: Students who obviously pleased are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够明显很高兴的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。

senses.en: an informal meeting of friends, relatives, or colleagues

ex.en: After the lecture, we used get-together in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了聚会。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up get-together while discussing evidence about social change.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了聚会。

tip: 名词带连字符；动词短语get together不带。

senses.en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface
a flat, thin, round object

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about hard disk.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于硬盘的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used hard disk to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用硬盘来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。

senses.en: Used to introduce the second point in a list or argument.

ex.en: The professor told us to secondly, consider and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们其次，考虑，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will secondly, consider when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会其次，考虑。

tip: 用于列举第二点，句首使用时后面通常加逗号。

senses.en: The process or result of becoming better.
A change that makes something better.

ex.en: Our professor circled significant improvement on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了显著改善。

ex.en: The reading connects significant improvement with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把显著改善和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an improvement on｜比…更好的事物
tip: 某方面的改善用 in；比原来更好用 an improvement on。

senses.en: Ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize courage in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出勇气。

ex.en: Students who can explain courage usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
ex.zh: 能解释勇气的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。

col: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事
tip: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

senses.en: To deal with a situation, task, or person.
To hold, touch, move, or control something with your hands.
The part of an object used for holding or moving it.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to handle complaints.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何处理投诉。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to handle complaints.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们处理投诉。

tip: handle作处理讲直接接宾语，不加with。

senses.en: to give something and receive something else in return
an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas
a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to exchange ideas.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何交流想法。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to exchange ideas.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们交流想法。

tip: exchange A for B表示用A换B，注意介词for。

senses.en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations.
Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about fully satisfied.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于完全满意的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects fully satisfied with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把完全满意和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。

senses.en: A document given to people attending a lesson or meeting.
Money or goods given free to someone in need.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on course handout.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论课程讲义。

ex.en: The reading connects course handout with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把课程讲义和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: handout是名词；hand out是动词短语，意为分发。

senses.en: Enjoying meeting people and spending time with them.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a sociable person.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于爱交际的人的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a sociable person.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得爱交际的人这个例子。

col: a sociable atmosphere｜友好的社交氛围
tip: sociable指爱交际；social多指社会或社交的。

senses.en: Something received for good work, helpful behaviour, or achievement.
To give something to someone for their efforts or help.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial reward.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济回报。

ex.en: The reading connects financial reward with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把经济回报和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: reward someone for something｜因某事奖励某人
tip: reward强调付出后的回报；award常指正式授奖。

senses.en: The people who work together on a ship or aircraft
A group working together on a particular practical task
Work as a member of a boat's crew

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on cabin crew.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论客舱乘务组。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of cabin crew.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得客舱乘务组这个例子。

tip: crew是集体名词；单个成员说a crew member。

senses.en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: The lab instructions say to defend against attack.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求抵御攻击。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to defend against attack.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来抵御攻击。

col: defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护
tip: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

senses.en: People watching or listening to a performance, speech, or programme
People who read or receive particular content

ex.en: Office hours began with a large audience.
ex.zh: 答疑从众多观众开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of a large audience.
ex.zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得众多观众这个例子。

col: reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众
tip: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

senses.en: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a state of emergency.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论紧急状态。

ex.en: The reading connects a state of emergency with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把紧急状态和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下
a state of emergency｜紧急状态
tip: 是可数名词；emergency exit中的名词作定语。

senses.en: To study material again in preparation for an examination.
To change something to correct or improve it.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to revise for an exam.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须复习备考。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to revise for an exam.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来复习备考。

col: revise for an exam｜复习备考
tip: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

senses.en: Completing a course of study, or the ceremony celebrating this.

ex.en: Office hours began with after graduation.
ex.zh: 答疑从毕业后开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss after graduation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论毕业后的材料。

tip: 表示从某校毕业，动词用graduate from。

senses.en: Someone who receives customers' payments in a shop or bank

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on supermarket cashier.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论超市收银员。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of supermarket cashier.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得超市收银员这个例子。

col: work as a cashier｜当收银员
pay the cashier｜向收银员付款
tip: cashier负责收款，accountant负责会计核算。

senses.en: Something bought for less than its usual price
To discuss prices or conditions to reach an agreement
An agreement about what each person will do

ex.en: I copied a real bargain into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把真正的便宜货抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a real bargain to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用真正的便宜货来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: a real bargain｜真正的便宜货
bargain with someone｜与某人讨价还价
keep your side of the bargain｜履行自己约定的义务
tip: 便宜货用可数名词；bargain with sb表示与某人议价。

senses.en: Related to feelings rather than thoughts or physical needs.
Showing or experiencing strong feelings.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on emotional support.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论情感支持。

ex.en: The reading connects emotional support with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把情感支持和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: emotional不一定指悲伤，也可指喜悦等强烈情绪。

senses.en: To teach someone and develop their knowledge or skills.
To give people information about a particular subject.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to educate children.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须教育儿童。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers educate children before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要教育儿童。

col: educate people about｜向人们普及……知识
tip: educate强调教育培养；teach也可直接接学科。

senses.en: Feeling admiration because someone or something is particularly good.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about deeply impressed.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于印象极为深刻的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects deeply impressed with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把印象极为深刻和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: impressed描述人的感受；impressive描述令人赞叹的事物。

senses.en: to do what someone orders or what a rule requires

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to obey orders.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须服从命令。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to obey orders.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们服从命令。

tip: 直接接人、命令或规则，不加to：obey the law。

senses.en: a feeling of great enthusiasm and eager anticipation
something that creates strong interest or enthusiasm

ex.en: Our professor circled a sense of excitement on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了兴奋感。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a sense of excitement.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论兴奋感的材料。

col: contain your excitement｜抑制兴奋之情
tip: 表示兴奋情绪通常不可数：with excitement。

senses.en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly
An act of violence or strong criticism
A sudden period of illness or severe symptoms

ex.en: The professor asked us to attack a proposal.
ex.zh: 教授让我们抨击一项提案。

ex.en: The passage says students who can attack a proposal follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够抨击一项提案的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: come under attack｜遭到攻击或抨击
attack a proposal｜抨击一项提案
tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an attack on。

senses.en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true.
Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.

ex.en: Indeed, the class checked the chart a second time.
ex.zh: 确实，全班又核对了一次图表。

ex.en: Indeed, the lecture treats the two trends as related rather than identical.
ex.zh: 确实，讲座把这两种趋势视为相关，而不是同一回事。

col: very useful indeed｜确实非常有用
tip: 可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

senses.en: air moving into or out of your lungs
one act of taking air into your lungs

ex.en: I copied out of breath into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把上气不接下气抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss out of breath.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论上气不接下气的材料。

col: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气
out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

senses.en: a teacher who guides individuals or small groups
to teach someone individually or in a small group

ex.en: I copied private tutor into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把私人教师抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of private tutor.
ex.zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得私人教师这个例子。

col: tutor someone in maths｜辅导某人数学
tip: tutor强调个别或小组辅导，不一定是教授。

senses.en: A condition causing illness after contact with a normally harmless substance

ex.en: Office hours began with food allergy.
ex.zh: 答疑从食物过敏开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used food allergy to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用食物过敏来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 常用have an allergy to；to后接引起过敏的物质。

senses.en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time
a country, its government, or a region within a country
to express something clearly in speech or writing

ex.en: The textbook introduces state of mind in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了心理状态。

ex.en: The author returns to state of mind when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了心理状态。

col: in a good state｜处于良好状态
tip: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。
